I arrived with my dog ​​after 6pm on Friday evening, shortly before closing. I was greeted almost immediately, everyone was very kind and sweet to me and my dog. He was examined, given an injection of medicine. I can only recommend it.

We really like the friendly atmosphere and that our dog Günther is a star in the office. He gets so much love that he enjoys going to the doctor. Dániel Baranyi was our previous dog's vet and we love him very much. I can only recommend him. I can't comment on the prices because I haven't looked at the prices of other vets since we've been coming here. Plus, there's free parking in front of the building.
They are very kind, animal-loving and affordable! I recommend them to everyone!

A real miracle clinic! The assistants are fairies, the doctors are kind wizards. They are friendly, kind, and benevolent. No unnecessary fuss, no pointless sedation - for the owner, that is! Fast, accurate, precise, professional. God bless them!
The team was very helpful. We got there at 11:00 on Saturday and it was our turn at 11:50, so the opening hours are 12:00!! Thank you very much for your help, Gábor, Lina, Radoszt!!
Fast, kind, professional service. We love it.
I was there today with my 6 year old staff. I received a very correct human approach! The dog is fine. I can only recommend it!
A very kind and attentive team works here. They are always helpful and pay attention to every little detail. I can only recommend it! 🐾💙 …
We have been coming here from across town for many years. In addition to their expertise, the doctors are also kind and patient. We are extremely satisfied.
Gábor Winter is the best veterinarian in the world

Unfortunately, PÖTYIKE has left us for good in recent days and the organization of the cremation was a great help for us.
I can recommend PET-VET Pet Ambulance to all OWNERS.

We go to them with my cat; examination, vaccination, neutering, etc... They are kind, helpful, both doctors and assistants! Friendly environment, with very good professionals. I am very satisfied with them. I can only recommend them.

A week ago I had a negative opinion about Dr. Zoltán István Pák, our first meeting did not go well, I deleted my opinion at that time, and now I would like to share my new observation. My 16-year-old dog requires professional medical care and attention due to serious age-related diseases (liver, kidney, heart, joints), which he is already receiving. I am grateful to the doctor and Dr. Mónika Molnár for conscientiously using all their knowledge to help my little dog, and for doing everything they can to make the rest of his life pain-free. I wholeheartedly recommend him to everyone for his conscientious attitude, knowledge, and expertise. Thank you again for helping my little one!

Dear Pet-Vet Pet Clinic!

We visited you for the first time, today between 9:30 and 10:00 we were received by Dr. Zoltán István Pák, a veterinarian. We would like to express our gratitude for the doctor's attitude and professional preparation. We got to know an extremely patient, attentive and conscientious specialist in person.

We visited the clinic for a chest X-ray examination and combined vaccination. The doctor informed us about everything in detail and clearly, which gave us a great sense of security.

We hope that our satisfied feedback will reach him as well.

Thank you:

Latyak and its owners

My dog ​​had surgery here, and it was the worst experience of my life. Immediately after the hernia surgery and neutering, he screamed profusely, but they told me it was normal. At home, he just wouldn't stop crying and breathing heavily. I went to the 24-hour hospital that night, where they gave him opioids. The stitches eventually became infected, and it took a month to heal. When we called the doctor, he said, "He's not the first and won't be the last dog to have this kind of surgery."
We went to another clinic to have the stitches removed, and it took them a very long time. As a result, my dog ​​was left traumatized, and now even grooming is a problem for us, even though he's always been the most patient boy. I'm so sorry I took him and trusted this clinic; it was a huge mistake, and I'll have to deal with the consequences. I'll also say that they didn't give me any paperwork even after the surgery, or at any of my appointments, even though all the clinics always give me official paperwork with my medical history and prescriptions stamped on it.
I spent a fortune on doctor's visits afterward, and the hernia they removed came back. I'll never set foot in that clinic again, and I advise you to avoid this place, which can't even provide adequate anesthesia. Please don't make the mistake I did.
Expert, kind doctors, people

A really well-equipped, family-run medical office.
They are very attentive to the animals, they work very nicely and well.
They are careful, they cleaned and pulled my little old dog's teeth.
They didn't charge me for an ultrasound scan unnecessarily, but the Doctor examined my dog ​​thoroughly several times to see if he could be sedated.
We didn't have to wait long.
Really great place!
I can only recommend it. We went to two doctors for vaccinations and examinations. We went on time. We met very kind and professional doctors. I can only recommend them.
Conscientious doctors, well-equipped clinic!!!

We went for the first time on Wednesday with my dog, who was in very bad condition. Another vet sent us to have a heart ultrasound done here. Dr. Zoltán Pák did the ultrasound, which didn't show any abnormalities, but he wouldn't let her rest, so he also checked her with an abdominal ultrasound, and on Monday the other vet checked her. Dr. Pák immediately noticed that the dog's uterus was full of pus. He recommended immediate life-saving surgery. He discussed everything with the Csipet Tsapat animal clinic over the phone. The dog was successfully operated on. The next day we took him back to him for a check-up, he was very conscientious, I received all the necessary medication and equipment. I highly recommend the doctor to everyone and thank you very much for the dedicated and precise work!
Excellent animal-friendly professionals
The doctor was very patient and kind. He answered all my questions.
They are always very kind and treat the little ones well. I can only recommend them.
Horror prices

The best veterinary clinic in Pesterzsébet! I have had positive experiences both professionally and personally. They answer the phone immediately, they were able to make an appointment for a close appointment, everyone treated my cat in such a way that both he and I were completely calm. I received exhaustive answers to all my questions. There is no long wait, it is easy to park in front of the clinic, and all the important equipment is on site, so we don't have to take our little pets anywhere else for more serious examinations. Special thanks to Dr. Zoltán Pák for his patience and professional expertise, it was a pleasure to be with him with my cat Misi.
Conscientious doctors, helpful staff. We have been coming here for a very long time.
Nice doctor and assistant. They helped us well with the dog and are much more affordable than in the Netherlands.
Professional, kind and helpful doctors and assistants. With Dr. Dániel Baranyi, we can be sure our dog is in the best hands. I can only recommend him.
They were very helpful with my dog ​​and me. All my appreciation.
They are kind, very fast, and do their job professionally!

They are very kind, helpful and professional. They even accepted me when I didn't have an appointment and my cat had a battery problem, they also gave the injection so skillfully that he didn't even feel it. They don't judge if the cat is out of sorts. 🫶 …

The employees are very kind, every time we felt like we had been coming here for a thousand years. I can only recommend them!
The best animal doctors. ❤️

I definitely recommend the place.
I can only recommend it wholeheartedly!

Super place, with super doctors❤️🥰 I've been going there with my dog ​​and cat for decades🥰 maximum knowledge, empathy, honesty and hygiene above all 🥰 only PET VET 🥰❤️ small animal clinic …
Very prepared, empathetic doctors.
Fantastic English speaking vet who helped with the tapeworm and paperwork.  Would highly recommend

Huge thanks to the staff there. Professional care, maximum attention.
Zara thanks you very much, she is doing well. She is once again joining the group of active German Vizslas.
Professionalism, thoroughness, good doctors.

We have been going to the clinic for almost 30 years, especially to Dr. László Antal. All our dogs loved him and still love him. Kind, calm, empathetic, professional. Thank you for your care so far and for the future. 😊 …

I highly recommend it. Excellent place. Very precise and professional care. We have taken one kitten for examination so far, but we will take the other three here for vaccinations and annual check-ups.

We took our cat for a heart ultrasound, the team is very professional, kind, they explain everything, they care about the animals immensely. These are the most important things for me. They don't rush you, they take their time with everything, and they wait for feedback even if the cat is better, so there is also "aftercare". The access by car is also excellent, there is always parking.
I can only recommend it!

Zero professional knowledge. We took our kitten to the clinic in a very bad condition, they said she had tooth and gum inflammation... she received a few drops of infusion which she could not resolve with great difficulty, she was given it under the skin... Her already weak vein burst. She did not consider a body temperature of 35 degrees to be a bad sign (but it is a very bad sign) and they forced her to have surgery to remove tartar! The kitten was completely dehydrated. They treated her roughly the whole time and she was literally between life and death. By the afternoon, the kitten's condition had seriously deteriorated due to improper medical care. We took her to another doctor, as we explained the symptoms and complaints, three came to help the kitten. Unlike you!!! When they left the examination room five times during the examination, they did not pay attention to us properly, they took the seriousness of the situation lightly! Now, thanks to you, we are praying for the morning. In a patient in such a condition, incorrect and negligent care can lead to a serious tragedy! They don't deserve one star, but a thorough cleaning and investigation to see if they can even work in the profession! As I read the other reviews, this was not the first case, but I really hope it is the last!
Maximum expertise, kindness! There is nothing like them!
We would like to thank Dr. Pák for his extraordinary work with our puppy! His expertise, helpfulness, and calming demeanor helped us and our puppy a lot!

On January 9, 2025, we took our 5-year-old female dog (Yorkie) to be spayed, then 2 days after the surgery we experienced bleeding. I immediately took her back. DR. LÁSZLÓ ANTAL said that this was just a small urinary tract infection that needed antibiotic treatment. I mentioned that my dog ​​was bleeding not only when peeing, but also all day long!! He said for sure that it was just a cold, OKAY I TRUSTED HIM, THE DOCTOR KNOWS BETTER. We went for antibiotic treatment for 1 week, which of course didn't help, which I told him several times during the days, then he took himself to an ultrasound where he wasn't the one who examined him, and there it turned out that there was a big problem, his body didn't accept the internal suture (it turned out after 1 week), he had to point the finger and my dog ​​died during the second surgery (JAN18, 2025) because his body couldn't handle the second surgery, maybe it would be found out earlier what was wrong if DR ANTAL LASZLO PAY ATTENTION TO WHAT I SAY, MY DOG IS STILL ALIVE NOW, what kind of doctor is this? You can't immediately send a dog to the ER, so I've mentioned several times that I think there's something else going on here. This place doesn't cost a forint. If you can, avoid them from afar. They're useless. ANYONE WHO TAKES THEIR DOG HERE SHOULD AVOID "DR" LASZLÓ ANTAL FROM A FAR AWAY. THE WHOLE PLACE IS A BIG ZERO!!!!!!!!!!

We went to see Dr. Winter for an X-ray. He and his assistant welcomed us very kindly and friendly. We were informed about everything, the doctor explained everything, and I was able to take my dog ​​inside during the X-ray. I can only recommend them! Thank you very much 🐾🐾 …
professional team

We have been coming here for a long time, we are satisfied.
What we don't understand is the medicine being given at double the price. Ok, add 10-20-30%, but not 100%, because that's nonsense, that's a scam!

He has been caring for our rescued and kept animals for 30 years, to our utmost satisfaction, which is no small feat. In his work - and rightly so - the priority is dictated by the welfare interests of the animal and not the owner.

It was an extremely pleasant experience and a great help from you! My otherwise aggressive and unexamined cat was calmed, stroked and was able to complete the examination and treatment in a completely calm state! You already received a 5-star rating from me 2 years ago, but if I could, I would give it another 6! Thank you very much for the pleasant, calm, helpful care!

Unfortunately, it turned out afterwards that the ears of my absolutely ear-mite-ridden cat were completely mistreated and despite the thorough examination of the ear discharge by the kind doctor, he could not recognize the problem, so we had to go to another clinic where we received immediate help.
